title: HARP BAA Acceptance Event
description: A signed, append-only record that an agent's controlling organization accepted the Business Associate Agreement. PHI scopes remain unobtainable until this event completes. Combines the POST /agent/baa/accept request fields with the issued acceptance result.

org_id.description: Identifier of the controlling organization that accepts the BAA.

baa_version_hash.description: Content hash of the accepted BAA terms, matching agent_auth.harp.baa.version_hash, for example sha256:...

accepted_by.description: Identifier of the workforce member or principal who accepted on behalf of the organization.

signature.description: Signature over the acceptance payload, binding org, version, and acceptor.

baa_acceptance_id.description: Identifier assigned to the recorded acceptance event.

scopes_unlocked.description: PHI scopes that become obtainable once this acceptance completes.

accepted_at.description: Timestamp the acceptance was recorded, in RFC 3339 form.
